name: University of Chemistry and Technology, Prague
summary: Prague chemistry university: two English chemistry bachelor's with specialisations, plus Economics and Management; your fee is fixed for the degree.

ib.text: No recognition procedure for the IB: ask your IB coordinator to release your results to UCT Prague through the IB system. Chemistry degrees test maths and chemistry online; no IB points minimum.

programmes.name: Chemistry and Technology (Faculty of Chemical Technology)
programmes.about: Chemistry and chemical technology at the Faculty of Chemical Technology; during year one you choose catalysis and manufacturing of (in)organic compounds, inorganic, medicinal or organic chemistry, or materials such as glass, metals and polymers.
programmes.ib: No English certificate is asked for: the interview is in English. Upload a health certificate from your doctor with the application.
programmes.selectionNote: Online entrance exam in maths and chemistry (at least 40% in each part), then an interview; AP Calculus 4 or 5 can waive it. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

family.name: Chemistry and Technology
family.cardLine: Synthesis, catalysis, medicinal and organic chemistry
family.differs: Specialise in catalysis and synthesis, inorganic, medicinal or organic chemistry, or materials.

programmes.name: Chemistry and Technology (Faculty of Chemical Engineering)
programmes.about: Chemistry and chemical technology at the Faculty of Chemical Engineering; during year one you choose physical and computational chemistry, analytical chemistry or chemical engineering, with early chances to join research teams.
programmes.ib: No English certificate is asked for: the interview is in English. Upload a health certificate from your doctor with the application.
programmes.selectionNote: Online entrance exam in maths and chemistry (at least 40% in each part), then an interview; AP Calculus 4 or 5 can waive it. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

family.name: Chemistry and Technology
family.cardLine: Physical, analytical chemistry or chemical engineering
family.differs: Specialise in physical and computational chemistry, analytical chemistry or chemical engineering.

programmes.name: Economics and Management
programmes.about: Economics, management, marketing and finance for work in international teams, with a Marketing or International Trade concentration; a four-year version adds a first year strengthening English, maths and business terms.
programmes.ib: B2 English: pass UCT's English test, send a recognised certificate, or show a school-leaving exam from a school taught in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Online maths and English test (30% minimum in each) and an interview; a B2 certificate or schooling in English waives the English part. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: The tuition fee of the year you start in stays the same for the whole programme, so you know the full cost up front.
The chemistry application needs a health certificate from your doctor, issued no more than four months before the application deadline.
You apply once to a chemistry programme and pick your specialisation during the first year.
